subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session discard that session’s queued follow-up and lane work, or should it cancel only the currently active run?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible, but queue deletion changes the user-visible meaning of stop and cannot be settled mechanically by tests or protocol compatibility alone.

options.title: Adopt stop-and-clear semantics
options.body: Merge only after final-head proof demonstrates that selected-session `/stop` intentionally clears its queued successor while preserving other sessions.

options.title: Preserve queued work
options.body: Revise the UI path to abort only the active selected run and leave queued follow-up or lane work available to continue.

options.title: Expose separate actions
options.body: Keep `/stop` run-scoped and add a separately named, explicitly confirmed queue-clearing action if that workflow is needed.

recommendation.title: Adopt stop-and-clear semantics
recommendation.body: Merge only after final-head proof demonstrates that selected-session `/stop` intentionally clears its queued successor while preserving other sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active and predecessor implementations and can clarify the observed channel-session workflow while a feature owner confirms the durable UX policy.
